scholarships.title: International Major Entrance Scholarship (IMES), University of British Columbia

existing.description: The International Major Entrance Scholarship is a merit-based award for exceptional international students entering undergraduate programs at UBC, awarded in the first year of study and renewable for up to three additional years. For the 2026/2027 academic year UBC states awards will be valued at $10,000 to $25,000 per year, with the number and level varying depending on available funding. Consideration is automatic: no separate application is needed as long as the applicant applies to UBC by the admissions deadline, which for September 2027 entry is January 15, 2027 at 11:59 p.m. PST. Applicants must be new to UBC, entering directly from secondary school, and studying on a Canadian study permit, and cannot be nominated for a need-and-merit International Scholars award. UBC explicitly states these merit-based awards do not cover the full cost of education and that financial need is not considered.
eligibility: Be new to UBC, entering directly from secondary school
Be an international student who will be studying at UBC on a Canadian study permit (student visa); changes to citizenship status affect IMES eligibility
Demonstrate exceptional academic achievement and intellectual promise
Demonstrate impressive extracurricular and community involvement
Not be nominated for a need-and-merit-based International Scholars award
Apply to UBC by the admissions deadline
existing.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be new to UBC entering directly from secondary school, hold a Canadian study permit, demonstrate exceptional academic achievement and intellectual promise with impressive extracurricular and community involvement, not be nominated for a need-and-merit International Scholars award, and apply to UBC by the admissions deadline.
benefits: Entrance award of $10,000-$25,000 per year (2026/2027 academic year)
Renewability for up to three additional years of study
Automatic consideration with the UBC undergraduate application
coverage: Award valued at $10,000-$25,000 per year for the 2026/2027 academic year
Renewable for up to three additional years of study
Not full cost of education: UBC states these awards do not cover the full cost of education
requirements: Submit the UBC undergraduate application by the admissions deadline to be considered
Be new to UBC and entering directly from secondary school
Hold a Canadian study permit at the time of study
documents: UBC undergraduate admissions application submitted by January 15, 2027
Secondary school documents required for admission assessment
Personal profile and extracurricular history supplied through the UBC application
existing.english_requirement: Applicants must meet UBC's English Language Admission Standard for direct entry to the degree.
application_method: Submit the UBC undergraduate admissions application online at myapplication.ubc.ca

No separate IMES application is required: UBC states that if you apply to UBC by the admissions deadline you will automatically be considered for the International Major Entrance Scholarship and the Outstanding International Student Award
Respond to any award offer before the admission acceptance deadline, which is usually May 1
existing.selection_notes: Merit-based awards are evaluated on the applicant's academic and personal profile. All international undergraduate applicants are considered, so the process is highly competitive. Admissions decisions and award evaluations are separate processes; award decisions are made between mid-February and the end of April, and only successful recipients are notified. Award offers are final.
existing.best_fit: Exceptional international secondary school leavers with strong grades and significant extracurricular or community involvement who are applying to an undergraduate program at UBC Vancouver or UBC Okanagan.
existing.application_period: Annual. For September 2027 entry the online application opened in early October 2026 and applications are due January 15, 2027 at 11:59 p.m. PST. Scholarship decisions are made between mid-February and the end of April.
existing.deadline_display: Apply to UBC by the admissions deadline: January 15, 2027 (11:59 p.m. PST), the deadline to apply for Winter Session (September 2027 to April 2028). The IMES has no separate application form; applying to UBC by the admissions deadline is the eligibility requirement.
existing.program_type: Merit-based, automatically considered entrance scholarship for international students entering an undergraduate program at UBC directly from secondary school.

scholarships.title: McMaster University Award of Excellence (International Fee-Paying Students)

existing.description: The McMaster University Award of Excellence is McMaster's most prestigious international entrance award, valued at up to $200,000 over four years and renewable in Levels 2 to 4. It is open to international students paying international tuition fees who enter the Faculty of Business, Engineering, Humanities, Science or Social Sciences and who exemplify the highest standards of academic and personal achievement. Applicants must apply through AwardSpring and are assessed on personal growth and achievement, community engagement and contribution, and self-reflection. For the 2027 entry cycle applications open on November 1, 2026 and close on February 19, 2027 at 11:59 p.m. ET. Recipients must remain in their originally admitted faculty, stay enrolled full-time and continue paying international tuition fees in order to renew, so the award does not cover tuition.
eligibility: International student paying international tuition fees
Entering one of the eligible faculties: Business, Engineering, Humanities, Science or Social Sciences
Shows great potential as a student scholar at McMaster University
Exemplifies McMaster University's values of excellence, engagement and personal growth
To renew: remain enrolled in the faculty to which they were originally admitted, maintain full-time enrolment status and continue to pay international student tuition fees
existing.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be international students paying international tuition fees, entering an eligible faculty (Business, Engineering, Humanities, Science or Social Sciences), and exemplify the highest standards of academic and personal achievement. McMaster evaluates demonstrated personal growth, community engagement and self-reflection, and the recipient must remain enrolled in the original faculty, stay full-time and continue paying international fees to renew.
benefits: Up to $200,000 in award support over four years
Renewability each year in Levels 2 to 4
Recognition as McMaster's most prestigious international entrance award
coverage: Award valued at up to $200,000 over four years (Level 1 entry, renewable in Levels 2-4)
Amount is determined by the Faculty and based on the student's enrolled course load as required by their program
Does not cover international tuition fees, which recipients continue to pay
requirements: McMaster English Language Development (MELD) applicants must use the McMaster University Award of Excellence Form for MELD instead
Be enrolled in the original admitted faculty and maintain full-time enrolment to renew
Continue to pay international student tuition fees to renew
documents: Completed application through AwardSpring (or the McMaster University Award of Excellence Form for MELD)
application_method: Submit the application through AwardSpring at mcmaster.awardspring.ca/signin
MELD applicants submit the separate McMaster University Award of Excellence Form for MELD
Respond to the three published selection criteria in the application
existing.selection_notes: Applicants are evaluated on their ability to demonstrate Personal Growth and Achievement (a meaningful learning experience and what was gained), Community Engagement and Contribution (positive impact through helping others), and Self-Reflection (insight into personal values, choices or goals).
existing.best_fit: Incoming international fee-paying undergraduates with a top academic record and a demonstrable record of personal growth, community contribution and reflective leadership, entering Business, Engineering, Humanities, Science or Social Sciences at McMaster.
existing.notes: Award amounts are determined by the Faculty and based on the student's enrolled course load as required by their program; the final value is confirmed following enrolment. The same page carries a stale date for a different award - the Faculty of Engineering Global Dean's Excellence Award is listed as "Deadline to apply is February 19, 2026", a year behind the umbrella Award of Excellence deadline of February 19, 2027.
existing.application_period: Annual. The application opens November 1st and closes February 19 at 11:59 p.m. ET for the following Fall term.
existing.deadline_display: Application deadline: February 19, 2027 at 11:59 p.m. ET. Applications open November 1st, 2026.
existing.program_type: Entrance award for international fee-paying undergraduates, renewable across Levels 2 to 4.
